There are two male NPC's name '''Vetto''', one is a nobleman and the other, a salesman. They both can be found in {{Location|Capitoline Hill}}.

==Nobleman Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Vetto:''' Gladiators undergo extensive training each day. If they want to have their names on the leaderboard, they'll need to put in the extra work.
:'''Vetto:''' Gladiating was never an easy sport.

==Salesman Dialogue==
;(Day)
:'''Vetto:''' Would you like to experience a day in the life of a Champion Gladiator? 
:{{DIcon}} A day in the life of a Champion Gladiator?
:'''Vetto:''' That's right! Want to be a champion? Want to win in the arena and be forever remembered as a hero?
:'''Vetto:''' We're launching a Champion Gladiator Itinerary package. If you complete all the activities in the package, you'll get a mystery grand prize!
:'''Vetto:''' Over a hundred people have signed up so far, but no one has lasted till the end.
:'''Vetto:''' Will you be the first one to complete the itinerary?

;(Night)
:'''Angry Customer:''' What Champion Gladiator Itinerary package?! It's just a rip-off!
:'''Angry Customer:''' All you guys did was make up a schedule to prey on us fans!
:'''Vetto:''' Calm down now. Hear me out...
{{Dialogue End}}
